questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the health endpoints are wired up for use by an orchestrator? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The Redis ping hangs for 10 seconds while Postgres answers instantly. About how long does a readiness request take and what status does it return?
choices: About 800 ms, returning 200 because Postgres is healthy
About 1.6 s, because the checks run one after another
About 10 seconds, returning 200 once Redis answers
About 800 ms, returning 503 with the redis check marked not ok

questions.prompt: What does the shutdown sequence in Server.Run do about traffic from the load balancer?
choices: It makes readiness return 503, waits 5 seconds so the balancer stops routing, then calls Shutdown with a 20 second limit
It waits for ctx to be cancelled again before shutting down
It relies on liveness failing to remove the pod from the balancer
It immediately closes the listener, so in-flight requests are dropped

questions.prompt: Why is the results slice in run safe to write from several goroutines without a mutex?
choices: The compiler serializes writes inside closures
Each goroutine writes only to its own index, and wg.Wait establishes happens-before before the slice is read
The goroutines run one at a time because of the context
